name: River Development Agent Controlled Execution Attestation Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTION ATTESTATION FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-283 consumes only the exact DEV-282 controlled execution audit result contract.
DEV-283 denies attestation when the DEV-282 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, unaudited, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required audit evidence.
DEV-283 creates deterministic attestation data only.
DEV-283 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-283 does not retry execution.
DEV-283 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-283 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-283 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-283 preserves predecessor provenance and the complete execution/audit evidence chain.
DEV-283 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-283 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-283 does not modify repository content.
DEV-283 does not delete repository content.
DEV-283 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-283 does not commit.
DEV-283 does not push.
DEV-283 does not deploy.
DEV-283 does not access secrets.
DEV-283 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-283 does not perform network execution.
DEV-283 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution verification boundary is required before downstream progression.
